'''Selima DeWitt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
DeWitt lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was the daughter of [[Davin DeWitt]], the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]]. She often hung around in the [[Space Monkey Café]] and the club [[Tyger Burning Bright]], becoming acquainted with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Narask]] and the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tyburn Welles]].<ref name="Find the Lady" />

When [[Percival Vale]] arrived on Cularin, DeWitt began a relationship with him. They went to live in the city [[Gadrin]], where they joined the [[Bark Lovers' Alliance]], a local environmental group, and set up the shop [[Natural]]. However, [[Higgie Sethven]], a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who worked in the shop, began developing a powerful drug there and the companies [[Culpharm]] and [[Genasys]] both sent corporate security teams to the shop, to try and obtain the drug. In the resulting shoot-out, DeWitt, Vale and Sethven took cover inside the shop and were eventually rescued by a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] whom DeWitt's father had hired to find her, as she had been out of contact with him.<ref name="Find the Lady" />

DeWitt returned to Bayonard and with her father's blessing, and married Vale shortly afterward.<ref name="Find the Lady" />
